set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Single/multi-thread outputs meet reproducibility tolerances.
- Thread scaling targets only parallel kernels and documents oversubscription.
- Serial fallback is equivalent.
- Peak memory and densification are measured on large cases.
- Thread count/RNG/deterministic sampling are documented and tested.
- No races appear under stress/sanitizers.
set.title: Certify threading, determinism, and memory behavior
